content.text:
Done. Here's the report.

## What I did

**Identified the culprit from the screenshot:** the SUPPORT inbox (`support@nxeon.cloud`) is flooded with automated **`[Nxeon ops] Node capacity …`** emails — WARN / CRITICAL / cleared alerts about compute/hosting node RAM and DISK utilization. These come from the node-capacity monitor, not from any customer.

**Traced the sender:** `worker/monitor.ts` → `notifyNodeCapacity()`, which built `[Nxeon ops] …` emails and sent them `to: await supportEmail()` (line 99/105). This was the only ops/report category emailing the support inbox. The other `supportEmail()` callers are genuine customer-support paths and I left them untouched:
- `app/(marketing)/contact/page.tsx:35` (public mailto)
- `components/marketing/ContactForm.tsx:17`
- `lib/actions-contact.ts:44` (contact-form submissions)

## Changes

1. **`lib/settings.ts`**
   - Added setting default `reports_email: "reports@nxeon.cloud"` in `SETTINGS_DEFAULTS` (line 39) — configurable, so an operator can point it elsewhere.
   - Added helper `reportsEmail()` (after `supportEmail()`) that returns the `reports_email` setting, falling back to the default reports address — deliberately **not** to `support_email`, so clearing the field can't silently re-flood support.

2. **`worker/monitor.ts`**
   - Swapped the import `supportEmail` → `reportsEmail` (line 39).
   - `notifyNodeCapacity()` now sends the `[Nxeon ops]` capacity emails `to: await reportsEmail()` (line ~101), with a comment explaining the routing.

Note: the in-app admin notifications (`notifyAdmins`) and the disk/RAM `notifyAdmins` calls elsewhere in `monitorSweep` were already in-app only (no email), so nothing else needed changing.

## How
Via a configurable setting (`reports_email`) with a guaranteed-non-empty helper, defaulting to `reports@nxeon.cloud`. Customer-support routing is unchanged.

## tsc result
`npx tsc --noEmit` → **exit 0, clean**. (No `npm run build` was run, per constraints.)

## Owner action required
The **`reports@nxeon.cloud` mailbox likely needs to be created** in Mailcow — there was no pre-existing reference to it anywhere in the tree (the only hit is the new default I added). Until the mailbox exists, these ops alerts will bounce/blackhole. Alternatively, set the `reports_email` setting to an existing address. Per your memory notes, mailbox management is on Mailcow (get/verify via its API, not the local resolver).
